A short, source-backed connection

TPF’s plan identifies B for Charmey–Jaun.
The unlabelled arrival is not assigned to A.
The timetable keeps separate arrival/departure rows.
All ten full route patterns were reviewed.
Only the two contributing contexts change.
Reverse calls and platform C remain unchanged.
No loop or turnaround is introduced.
The eight-minute wait is not proof of movement.
Original coordinates and times are preserved.
© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 • selected object edits predate both fixtures; survey vintage unknown.
TPF platform plan and timetable are identity / call-order evidence only. No schematic map geometry extracted.
Inference is scoped to the original directed pair: at most 10 m per attachment and 35 m total. General limits unchanged.
Diagram checks geometry continuity. It does not establish the vehicle’s physical arrival position or movement during its wait.
